meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). Uses real Chrome with CDP to bypass anti-automation. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布推文和长文到 X。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post tweets and articles to X.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你把文字、图片、视频或长文章发布到 X（Twitter）。它会用真实的 Chrome 浏览器操作，绕过反自动化检测。
howto.when: 当你要求“发推”、“发布到 X”、“分享到 Twitter”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段话发到 X：今天天气真好！
say.note: Claude 会预览推文，确认后发布。

say.text: 把这张图片和文字一起发推。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片发推脚本。
Claude 会生成引用推文预览。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can post text, images, videos, or long-form articles to X (Twitter) using a real Chrome browser to bypass anti-automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

say_en.text: Post this to X: Great weather today!
say_en.note: Claude will preview the tweet before posting.

say_en.text: Tweet this image with the caption.
say_en.note: Claude will use the image post script.

say_en.text: Quote this tweet with a comment: https://x.com/...
say_en.note: Claude will generate a quote tweet preview.
